questions.q: What therapy does the book promote for handling emotions?
questions.why: The text repeatedly references ACT as the recommended approach.

questions.q: According to the book, what is a common mistake people make with negative emotions?
questions.why: It states people worsen emotions by trying to make them go away.

questions.q: What does ACT suggest about pursuing happiness directly?
a: Enjoy small pleasures without chasing them
questions.why: ACT advises thoughtfully enjoying pleasures rather than actively chasing happiness.

questions.q: What does the book say you can reliably control?
questions.why: It notes you can choose how to act, even if you can't control emotions.

questions.q: What final exercise does the book include for readers?
questions.why: The wrap‑up mentions exercises for determining what you really value.
